verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web-scraping API, so a marketplace of ready-made scrapers is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only its own first-party scrape, crawl, extract and map endpoints, plus SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server. Nothing shows a marketplace or catalog of prebuilt, community- or vendor-published scrapers that a developer can pick and run, and general-purpose endpoints are a different capability from a marketplace.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a ready-made scraper from a marketplace instead of building one from scratch
